tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Actions taken: (1) Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging). (2) Ran rollback to v2.3.0 across all production regions. The first attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator partial failure, leaving the service mixed (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). (3) Retried the rollback to v2.3.0, which completed in all regions. Current state: v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, eu-west; healthy=true; error rate 0.002. Follow-ups: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial failure, and confirm checkout traffic and error rates are normal.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions and is healthy again (error rate 0.002, down from 0.18). SEV2 incident INC-0001 is open and has paged on-call.

- **Target version:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** The first attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator partial failure, leaving the service mixed (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). I re-ran the rollback to v2.3.0, and it completed in all regions.
- **Incident:** The first incident request timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and it returned INC-0001 once, so there should be no duplicate. The summary covers the actions above and the partial failure.

Follow-ups for on-call: investigate why v2.3.1 failed and why the first rollback attempt halted, and confirm checkout traffic is normal.
